marketBrief.headline: Payrolls beat forecasts at 165,000 as Nasdaq rebounds from correction on chip buying
marketBrief.summary: The BLS reported 165,000 October jobs at 8:30 a.m. ET, with unemployment at 4.1%. By 10:46 a.m. ET Yahoo Finance showed the Nasdaq Composite up 1.9% and the S&P 500 up 1%, with the Dow about flat. Rate-hike odds for the Dec. 8-9 FOMC rose to 76.8% after the report (CME FedWatch via CNBC).
bullets: Nonfarm payrolls +165,000 in October vs. 59,000 Dow Jones forecast; unemployment 4.1% (BLS, 8:30 a.m. ET release; CNBC).
Nasdaq Composite +1.9%, S&P 500 +1.0%, Dow +0.1% at 10:46 a.m. ET (Yahoo Finance live page).
Nvidia +5.9%, AMD +10.2%, Micron +6.8%, Broadcom +4.9% in Friday's trading (Trading Economics daily summary).
Brent $96.93 (-1.38%) and WTI $89.17 (-1.49%) at 4:38 a.m. ET, the last oil quote in the sources reviewed (CNBC).
Average hourly earnings +0.4% m/m, +3.1% y/y vs. 2.9% estimate (CNBC).

calendar.why: Payrolls +165,000 vs. 59,000 Dow Jones forecast; unemployment 4.1% (BLS; CNBC).

calendar.event: Regular session opened after the Nasdaq correction
calendar.why: Nasdaq Composite logged its steepest one-day drop in 19 months on Thursday (Reuters, via Yahoo Finance).

calendar.event: Inflation data, to test whether 3.1% wage growth beats prices
calendar.why: Business Insider noted the wage-versus-inflation check is due Tuesday.
CME FedWatch odds for a quarter-point hike were 76.8% after the jobs report (CNBC).
